title: The Even Share
logline: At dawn, a beach-seine crew hauls in the night's catch and divides it by a traditional share system that everyone on the beach knows by heart. Every division is a small, quick test of what the crew will and won't hold back.

object.note: Object 3 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: The night's watch ends at dawn; on a southern beach another dawn's work, a hauled net, is divided into shares, and each division is a quick test of what is held back.

thread_out.thread: What is held back moves from the catch to a skill: a family workshop that teaches an outsider, but not everything.

requirements: A beach-seine fishing community that still practises a traditional share system
A crew willing to be filmed through a full haul and division
Predawn or dawn access to the beach
